event_name: Date 07 October 2018 Time 16:00 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 forced car 14 off the track in turn 16.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 6 points for the 12 month period)
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations read with Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2b of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, and determined that car 18 made contact with car 14 and forced car 14 off the track.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations read with
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 36 2018 Japanese Grand Prix Offence Car 18 Causing A Collision
